title: Counting recurrences for the permutation classes Av(1342) and Av(12453)
abstract: For a permutation pattern τ, let Av_n(τ) be the set of permutations of length n that avoid τ.  This formalization proves, for every n, that four recurrences from the source paper compute |Av_n(1342)| and |Av_n(12453)|. For 1342 they are the one-threshold recurrence W and the scalar kernel recurrence G, and for 12453 the literal two-threshold recurrence H and the transfer-kernel recurrence G.  These are the cases d = 1 and d = 2 of the paper's counting recurrences for the classes Av(12...d ⊕ 231), the direct sum of an increasing pattern and 231, whose kernel form gives polynomial-time algorithms for every fixed d (the complexity bounds themselves are not formalized).  The counting sequence of Av(1342) has been known since Bóna (1997).  That of Av(12453) was previously known only up to n = 38, from a program of Biers-Ariel that evaluates the recurrence H, and the paper uses its kernel algorithm to compute it up to n = 150 (that computation is not formalized).
